rationale: Extends the reviewed scenario to the accept round that the non-adopting resolution starts, on the same unit and obligation: the harness now follows the Accept to the replica that already committed the instance and the AcceptReply back to the recoverer, and the plan adds a second monitor and property on that event. This is a new artifact (new harness bytes and a new execution) rather than a repair of the reviewed one, so the confirmed finding keeps its basis while the consequence gets its own oracle. The violation recorded by the first property is unchanged.
